title: fix(app-shell): a New similar copy in a base's .custom pair lists and counts its grants on the base's objects
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVXAcmGAR1bhDPqdVjU9Kng)_
Fixes #29674

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio「权限」里，定制包（`.custom`）中的权限集现在会列出并统计它在基础包对象上的授权；「新建类似」复制出来的权限集不再显示「已授权 0 个对象」。
- 为什么改：管理员复制供应商权限集后看到一个空矩阵，会以为复制失败或重新手动授权，而服务端其实已保存了 8 个对象、3 个字段的授权。
- 风险与回滚：只改 Studio 前端的对象列表范围（定制包 = 本包 + 基础包），保存仍只写定制包的草稿，从不写基础包；普通包的权限集行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/permission-slice.ts`（`permissionObjectScopePackages`）、`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 的对象列表读取、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 权限页的范围提示。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm dev:showcase` 后对 `showcase_contributor` 调用 clone 接口，再打开 `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/access?surface=permission%3A新名字`，应看到「已授权 8 个对象 · 3 个字段覆盖」，提示条显示「本包及 ObjectStack Showcase 的对象 · 保存为草稿」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Object scope of a pair's set.** `permissionObjectScopePackages(packageId)` (new, `permission-slice.ts`) answers `[pair, base]` for a paired `BASE.custom` package, by the spec's pairing rule (`customizationBasePackageId` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`), and `[packageId]` for every other package. ADR-0146 D3: the pair receives the permission sets for its base, and it declares none of the base's objects.
- **The package door's load** (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`) lists the draft-overlaid objects of each scope package and keeps one row per object name. The slice, the counts and the save merge all read that list, so a pair's set now shows, counts and edits its grants on the base's objects. The save is unchanged: it writes the set's draft at its own package (the pair), and rows outside the scope are re-merged from a fresh read as before (ADR-0086 P0).
- **How the editor learns the base:** derived from its own `packageId` with the spec's pairing rule. No new prop and no new read.
- **The Studio Access note** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the access arm only): on an open set the pair adds, the chip reads "This package's and BASE_LABEL's objects · saved as draft" (zh 「本包及 BASE_LABEL 的对象 · 保存为草稿」), with a title that says why. Every other note is unchanged. Two new `@object-ui/i18n` studio keys, `engine.studio.access.bannerPair` and `engine.studio.access.bannerTitlePair`, in both locales the studio namespace has (`en`, `zh`).

## Tests

- `StudioDesignSurface.accessPairCopy-29674.test.tsx` (new): the real `StudioDesignSurface`, `AccessPillar` and `PermissionMatrixEditPage` over the real metadata client and a fetch stub (base read-only, its pair writable). A copy in the pair that grants 8 base objects and 3 field overrides lists the 8 objects, draws their grants and reads "8 objects granted · 3 field overrides"; its note names the base; an edit to a base object's grant PUTs only `/meta/permission/COPY?package=PAIR` with every grant kept, and no write names the base. CONTROL: the base's own set lists the base's objects and reads no pair object list.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.pairScope-29674.test.tsx` (new): the helper (a pair, a base, an ordinary package, a pair of a pair); a pair's set lists the pair's and the base's objects once each and saves a base-object grant into the pair's draft. CONTROL: an ordinary package's set lists only its own objects, and its save keeps another package's object and field rows byte-identical.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with an on-disk proof and a proven restore to HEAD:
  - the helper returns `[packageId]` again (scope to the pair's own objects): 6 of 9 cases red, the 3 controls green;
  - the note's pair branch forced off: 1 of 4 red (the note case).

<details><summary>Test runs (fix at cbaf5f95 / 82fbfd0e; re-run at the merged head 607c05c4)</summary>

- New files: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 9 passed (9). At 607c05c4 (after merging main): the new files plus 30 neighbouring suites, Test Files 32 passed (32), Tests 222 passed (222); app-shell and i18n type-check exit 0.
- Neighbouring suites (every `PermissionMatrixEditor*`, `permission-slice*`, Studio access suites, `oneSurface-28572`, `zh-base-term`, plus all of `packages/i18n`): Test Files 154 passed, Tests 1837 passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:phantom-deps`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Scope chip decision: on a pair's set it names the base by its display label; on the base's own sets, the OWD overview and the empty header it stays "This package's objects".
- A rejected object-list read still lists nothing, as before this change (one `.catch` around both reads); no new degradation.

## Verification

Live on `pnpm dev:showcase --fresh` (admin), the card's recipe: `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/showcase_contributor/clone` with `{name: qa_contrib_29674, label}` answered 200 in `com.example.showcase.custom`; `GET /api/v1/meta/permission/qa_contrib_29674?package=com.example.showcase.custom` read 8 objects and 3 fields. The Console ran from source (Vite) against that server.

- Before (main's sources): header 「已授权 0 个对象 · 0 个字段覆盖」, matrix 「没有匹配的对象。」, chip 「仅本包对象 · 保存为草稿」.
- After: header 「已授权 8 个对象 · 3 个字段覆盖」, the base's objects listed with their grants, chip 「本包及 ObjectStack Showcase 的对象 · 保存为草稿」 (en: "8 objects granted · 3 field overrides", "This package's and ObjectStack Showcase's objects · saved as draft").
- Edit: ticking Delete on `showcase_invoice` sent one PUT, `/api/v1/meta/permission/qa_contrib_29674?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom&surface=studio`; the pair's draft read back 8 objects, 3 fields, `showcase_invoice.allowDelete: true`; the base set `showcase_contributor` still reads `allowDelete: false`, and the base holds no drafts.
- CONTROL: the base's own set `showcase_contributor` reads 8 objects · 3 field overrides, read-only, as before.

Screenshots (project files `issue-29674/shots/`): `before-qa_contrib_29674-zh.png`, `after-qa_contrib_29674-zh.png`, `after-qa_contrib_29674-zh-edited.png`, `after-qa_contrib_29674-en.png`, `control-showcase_contributor-zh.png`.
